name: nova-proxy
description: Local bridge: 127.0.0.1:3551 -> the Nova global coordinator. Cobalt is hard-coded to redirect the game to 127.0.0.1:3551, so this forwards that (HTTP + WebSocket, with TLS to the coordinator) up to the shared server on clientfinder.tail0a8fd0.ts.net:8443. Run one per player machine in global P2P mode.
